#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, B;
    std::cin >> n >> B;
    std::vector<int> data(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> data[i];
    }

    int totalCuts = 0;
    int oddCount = 0;
    int evenCount = 0;
    std::vector<int> maxDifferences;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (data[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++evenCount;
        } else {
            ++oddCount;
        }
        if (evenCount == oddCount && evenCount != 0 && i != n - 1) {
            int maxDiff = std::max(data[i], data[i + 1]) - std::min(data[i], data[i + 1]);
            maxDifferences.push_back(maxDiff);
        }
    }

    std::sort(maxDifferences.begin(), maxDifferences.end());

    for (int maxDiff : maxDifferences) {
        if (B >= maxDiff) {
            ++totalCuts;
            B -= maxDiff;
        }
    }

    std::cout << totalCuts << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
